title: A push to a handed-in branch is refused until the last round's record is posted
why: Incident (coordinator 16:37 CST Nov 14, from lane page-grant's 16:36 report; n=1 lane, twice; triage read no code): the lane pushed to a handed-in branch twice before the last round's record was posted. A push moves the head and stales a record for the old head (kin: step records-page-before-ready). Guard (the lane's note; coordinator: "your call", so queued here): a push to a handed-in branch is refused until the record for the last round exists. Kin: step fix-push-needs-fail-record (ready: refuses a lane push on a PR whose FAIL round has no posted record); this step is wider (any round, a handed-in branch). First act of a lane: read that step and guard.py, say whether a widening of it covers this (one home per capability, rule building-one-home-per-capability) before building a second check; name the false alarms (a fix commit after a FAIL, a records-page push by the merge tool). Rule: building-mistake-names-its-guard.
